name: Mystery at Stonyford Bridge
source:
Welcome to Stonyford, a small town nestled in the mountains. Here, everyone knows each other, and your neighbors are like family. Nothing bad ever happens here...until now.

Play as Grey as he returns home from his first semester at college. The town is bursting with holiday spirit, and the night of your return, you are happy to go to the Christmas Fest and see all of your old friends. You could never have expected that after this night, your life would change.

When a close friend is found dead by apparent suicide, the town is grieving. You most of all. You are sure that your friend could not have killed herself, and it is up to you to find out if there is more behind her death.

Search the town, question the residents, find evidence, and uncover the secrets your friend left behind. Dive deeper into your own past, and try not to let your other friendships slip away. What truly is going on? Why did your friend commit suicide? Who is hiding secrets from you? Is there more going on in Stonyford than meets the eye, or are you slowly losing your grip on reality? Take a journey of self discovery and uncover the Mystery at Stonyford Bridge!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1127210/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到斯托尼福德，一座坐落在群山之间的小镇。这里人人相识，邻居亲如一家，从来不会发生什么坏事…直到如今。

你将扮演格雷，在大学第一学期结束后回到家乡。小镇洋溢着节日气氛，返乡当晚，你满心欢喜地参加圣诞庆典，与老朋友们重聚。你从未料到，这一夜之后，自己的人生将彻底改变。

一位挚友被发现身亡，看起来像是自杀。全镇陷入悲痛，而你尤其无法接受。你坚信她不可能自杀，因此必须亲自查明，她的死背后是否另有隐情。

搜寻小镇，询问居民，寻找证据，揭开朋友留下的秘密。深入探寻自己的过去，同时努力守护其他的友谊。究竟发生了什么？你的朋友为什么会自杀？谁在向你隐瞒秘密？斯托尼福德是否藏着不为人知的真相，还是你正在逐渐失去对现实的判断？踏上自我探索的旅程，揭开斯托尼福德桥的谜团吧！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1127210/]Steam[/url]]
